title: Nintendo Switch Sports
description:
Get moving* with Basketball**, Golf**, Soccer, Volleyball, Bowling, Tennis, Badminton, and Chambara (swordplay) using Joy-Con™ controllers! Controls are intuitive, so you can hit the court (or lanes, or field, or arena) and get started. With controlled motions you can curve your bowling ball, add spin to a tennis shot, or even use a Joy-Con with the included Leg Strap accessory to kick the ball in Soccer. Family and friends can join in on the fun on the same system*** or online****.

Play online and face opponents near and far to earn in-game rewards or aim for the Pro League

Face off against opponents worldwide and strive to reach the Pro League in every sport. As you play online in random matchmaking, redeem points you earn for in-game rewards like outfits, sports accessories, gear, and much more for your avatar. The selection of items rotates each week, so check back and see what’s in stock!

Play with friends and family in the same room or across the world

Bowl, spike, and duel with friends in all 8 sports! Pass a Joy-Con controller to a friend for some 1v1, 2v2, or a free-for-all that will get everyone moving. In Bowling, all players can bowl simultaneously—no waiting for your turn. Play each sport online, or team up with a friend on the same system to take on opponents near and far in team sports like Basketball, Volleyball and Tennis.

descriptionKu: Nintendo Switch Sports brings motion-controlled sports to Switch with intuitive Joy-Con actions, local party play, online matchmaking, cosmetic rewards, and free post-launch sport additions. Nintendo lists TV and Tabletop modes, but not Handheld mode, because the game relies on detached Joy-Con motion input.

gameplayPillars.title: Motion-controlled sports
gameplayPillars.description: Joy-Con motion maps real-world swings, kicks, and throws into sports actions.

gameplayPillars.title: Eight supported sports
gameplayPillars.description: Basketball, Golf, Soccer, Volleyball, Bowling, Tennis, Badminton, and Chambara provide varied rule sets.

gameplayPillars.title: Local party play
gameplayPillars.description: Several sports support multiple players on one system for family and party sessions.

gameplayPillars.title: Online matchmaking
gameplayPillars.description: Players can compete online for ranks and cosmetic rewards through Nintendo Switch Online features.

gameplayPillars.title: Leg Strap support
gameplayPillars.description: Some Soccer activities can use the Leg Strap accessory to translate real kicking motions.

worldSummary: Nintendo Switch Sports brings motion-controlled sports to Switch with intuitive Joy-Con actions, local party play, online matchmaking, cosmetic rewards, and free post-launch sport additions. Nintendo lists TV and Tabletop modes, but not Handheld mode, because the game relies on detached Joy-Con motion input.

storyChapters.title: Choose a Sportmate or Mii
storyChapters.body: Players begin by choosing and customizing an avatar for Spocco Square.

storyChapters.title: Learn individual sports
storyChapters.body: Each sport uses its own motion gestures, timing systems, scoring rules, and team structure.

storyChapters.title: Play locally with family
storyChapters.body: The game is designed around quick shared sessions using multiple Joy-Con controllers.

storyChapters.title: Compete online
storyChapters.body: Online play unlocks broader matchmaking and reward progression.

storyChapters.title: Return for updated sports
storyChapters.body: Free updates expanded the game with Golf and later Basketball, increasing its long-term variety.

faq.a: Yes. Nintendo marks it supported with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch.

verdictPros: Simple presentation works well for casual players
verdictCons: Requires space for safe motion play

Not designed as a realistic sports simulator
